jobs.title: Product Lead, App Ecosystem
jobs.description:
ABOUT POSSIBLE

We’re on a mission to end the debt cycle—and help our customers and their communities unlock economic mobility for generations to come. Join the team that’s making our goal a reality.

 

As a Public Benefit Corporation, our mission and responsibility are to help communities unlock economic mobility—with affordable credit products designed to improve financial health.

 

Since our founding, we’ve delivered over $1 billion in funding to more than 1 million customers and saved them over $500 million. At Possible, we’re building a new kind of consumer finance company, one that helps people stay out of debt rather than profit from keeping them in it.



Team Introduction

Possible exists to help everyday Americans build financial health — and our App Ecosystem team is the foundation that makes that possible at scale. We own the customer-level experiences and shared platform capabilities that every product at Possible builds on: the application flow, offer logic, shared services like identity verification, engagement and analytics tooling, and the composable frontend infrastructure that lets teams ship fast and safely.

This is a newly formed team, born out of a strategic reorg designed to solve one of our biggest challenges: Possible has grown from a single lending product to a portfolio of access products and services — but the infrastructure underneath was built for a one-product world. We're now building the connective tissue that turns a collection of individual products into a cohesive, multi-product platform that deepens customer relationships over time.

If you're energized by the idea of defining how a product-led fintech scales from "we have multiple products" to "we have a multi-product strategy," this team is where that work lives. You'll partner with a dedicated EM, a designer, and a team of 6-8 engineers — and the decisions you make will shape the experience for every customer and every product team at Possible.


The Role & Impact

As the Principal Product Manager for App Ecosystem, you'll own the shared frontend platform and customer-level infrastructure that every product team at Possible builds on. Your primary mandate is to define and scale the composable app foundation, shared services, and reusable patterns that make it safe and fast for teams to ship. You'll partner with engineering to shape an AI-first developer platform that enables both human engineers and AI agents to deliver frontend changes with confidence.

You'll own the product-agnostic layer of the Possible experience: shared services like identity verification and authentication, engagement and analytics tooling (Amplitude, Braze), and the app infrastructure (build, test, deploy) that underpins everything. Your job is to make sure product teams can launch and iterate on new experiences without reinventing infrastructure or building bespoke solutions. You'll define the standards, guardrails, and reusable building blocks that accelerate delivery across the organization.

This platform work directly enables Possible's most important strategic shift: moving from a single-product company to a multi-product platform. You'll lead the transition from our current model to a product-agnostic application experience, defining how customers access and move between products. You'll build the offer management system that determines what to present to each customer and allows non-engineering configuration of offers across channels and partnerships. And you'll develop the customer value optimization strategy that governs pricing, packaging, and product deepening across the portfolio.

This role reports directly to the Director of Product, has visibility across the entire product organization, and influences nearly every customer-facing decision at Possible. It will grow as the platform grows. If you build this well, you'll have built the system that Possible scales on for years.


What You'll Bring


Must-Have Competencies

 - Platform thinking with customer empathy. You can toggle between "how do I build a system that product teams can leverage" and "what does this actually feel like for the customer." You've worked on products that serve both internal teams and end users, and you know how to balance those needs.

 - Technical fluency with platform and infrastructure concepts. You don't need to write code, but you credibly partner with engineering on architecture, tooling, and developer experience decisions. You understand trade-offs around composability, reusable patterns, and what makes a platform safe and fast to build on.

 - Strong analytical and data skills. You build analyses yourself, defining segmentation, measuring impact, and making trade-off decisions with data, not just intuition. You're comfortable in SQL, spreadsheets, and analytics tools, and you use them daily.

 - High ambiguity tolerance and ownership drive. This is a new team with a greenfield mandate. There is no existing playbook. You thrive when you're defining the "what" and "how" from scratch, making decisions with imperfect information, and driving work forward without waiting for direction.

 - Customer value optimization experience. You've made product and pricing decisions that optimize for customer lifetime value across multiple products or services. You understand the economics of what to offer, to whom, and when — not just feature shipping, but the strategic layer above it.


Preferred Competencies

 - Experience building multi-product or marketplace frameworks. You've been through the transition from single-product to multi-product at a consumer company and understand the organizational, technical, and product design challenges that come with it.

 - Experience with offer management, decisioning, or personalization systems. You know how to build a system that decides what to show a customer and allows non-engineering configuration of offers — understanding concepts like decisioning logic, audience targeting, and offer lifecycle management.


Nice to Have

 - Consumer lending or fintech experience. Domain familiarity with credit products, underwriting, and regulatory considerations would accelerate your ramp, but the core skill is customer value optimization, which transfers across domains.


Key Behaviors We Value

At Possible, we live by our Cultural Values. For this role, we especially value:

 - 🔑 Act with Ownership. This is a new team with a greenfield mandate — no playbook, no predecessor to follow. You'll take personal responsibility for defining the multi-product strategy, making bold bets on architecture and customer experience, and driving outcomes with focus, urgency, and discipline. You'll think beyond your own tenure, building systems that Possible will scale on for years.

 - ⚖️ Scientific Approach. The multi-product framework, offer management system, and deepening strategy all require rigorous thinking — forming hypotheses, running experiments, and changing direction when the data says so. You'll bring intellectual honesty to trade-off decisions and foster respectful debate with engineering, design, and cross-functional partners to ensure the best ideas win.

 - 💙 Mission-Driven. Every decision you make — from product-agnostic application flows to offer decisioning logic — directly shapes how customers access and deepen their relationship with Possible. You'll obsess over the customer experience and make trade-offs that prioritize long-term customer value over short-term convenience.


This is a Hybrid position. We work in our centrally located office in downtown Seattle three days a week (M, T, and Th).


The compensation range for this role is $202,300 to $238,000. We also offer significant stock options, comprehensive benefits, a bonus plan, commuter benefits, and an excellent office space with complimentary drinks and food options.



With the backing of our venture investors— Union Square Ventures, Canvas Ventures, Euclidean Capital, and Unlock Venture Partners — a dedicated following of hundreds of thousands of customers, and an extraordinary team, we are unwavering in our fight for financial fairness. As one of only a few FinTech Public Benefit Corporations, we’ve baked our dual dedication to building a profitable and socially impactful company into our charter; we only succeed when our customers do too. Give us a shout if you’d like to help us ship financial products that protect consumers from predatory lending practices and promote economic health.


Possible Finance is dedicated to financial fairness and community empowerment. We welcome diverse perspectives and experiences to help us achieve our mission of unlocking economic mobility for generations to come.

Learn more about us as a Public Benefit Company https://www.possiblefinance.com/blog/we-are-now-a-public-benefit-corporation.

jobs.description:
ABOUT POSSIBLE

We’re on a mission to end the debt cycle—and help our customers and their communities unlock economic mobility for generations to come. Join the team that’s making our goal a reality.

 

As a Public Benefit Corporation, our mission and responsibility are to help communities unlock economic mobility—with affordable credit products designed to improve financial health.

 

Since our founding, we’ve delivered over $1 billion in funding to more than 1 million customers and saved them over $500 million. At Possible, we’re building a new kind of consumer finance company, one that helps people stay out of debt rather than profit from keeping them in it.




TEAM INTRODUCTION

At Possible, Product Marketing sits at the intersection of product, growth, and brand. The Product Marketing Team is responsible for Competitive Intelligence, Customer & Market Insights, Positioning & Messaging, Go-to-Market for Launches, Trust and Category Education, and Lifecycle and Retention Narratives.




THE ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES

The Product Marketing Lead quarterbacks the above functions as we research, scope, and bring specific new products to market. This role also drives continuous product adoption and iteration post-launch through customer validation, ongoing competitive intelligence post-launch, and campaigns that drive demand, adoption, retention, satisfaction, and revenue growth.

Reporting to the Director of Product Marketing, this role also partners with our CMO, CPO and CEO on product strategy and positioning.

This is a high-execution, high-impact IC role, built for someone who is ownership-driven and operates with high autonomy as Possible transitions into a multi-product platform.

You’ll have a seat at the table when we decide which products we add, how individual products fit together, and help us think through how features get packaged into our membership tiers. The Product Marketing Lead’s role will also impact how we position possible overall.

You should be comfortable communicating clearly and efficiently to C-level executives, working across departments, and move nimbly as priorities shift and new information lands. High agency and low ego go far at Possible and they are especially critical for this role. You collaborate generously, stay humble and keep a good sense of humor.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN:

 - Build and scale a competitive intelligence program that systematically monitors consumer trends, competitors, pricing, fees, features, App Store presence, and go-to-market activities.

 - Partner with company leadership and cross-functional teams to define product tiering, pricing, packaging, and market positioning for both existing and new offerings.

 - Influence company-wide product strategy, positioning and roadmap prioritization by bringing market, customer, and competitive insights into cross-functional decision-making.

 - Define and drive positioning, messaging, and promotional strategy for both the Possible platform and individual products, membership tiers, and features based on customer insights and data.

 - Own the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for new products and features, from customer insights, positioning, and messaging to launch planning and execution.

 - Partner with User Research to drive the right research objectives to make informed product decisions.

 - Use customer insights from User Research and quantitative performance data to continuously improve product adoption, retention, and ongoing messaging.




MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

 - 8+ years of relevant professional experience, with at least 6 years’ dedicated Product Marketing experience.

 - Proven track record of driving customer research, competitive intelligence and GTM, end to end (not just coordinating product launches).

 - B2C App and/or subscription-business experience (fintech preferred; gaming, health and wellness, or ecommerce also considered).

 - Strong messaging and positioning craft. You have previously developed a compelling narrative from scratch, tested it with customers, and translated the results into in-market assets to fuel the work of cross-functional teams.

 - Deep experience with product adoption analysis, and the ability to turn qualitative and quantitative insight into strategy and engagement opportunities.

 - Comfortable with data, analytics and customer research tools like Sigma, Amplitude, Databricks, and Fullstory or similar.

 - Experience gathering and synthesizing audience insights from qualitative and quantitative research, either individually or by partnering closely with the User Research team.

 - A track record of partnering with PMs and engineering managers to translate technical terms into clear customer-facing benefits and stories.

 - Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally to drive alignment and set goals across Product, Marketing, and Operations.




NICE TO HAVE:

 - B2C consumer fintech app experience, ideally in the lending/credit and/or EWA (earned wage access) industries.

 - Past experience as a strategy consultant, Product Manager, or Brand Manager - or comparable experience with high work quality bars.

 - Comfortable with data - able to read/adapt SQL queries.

 - Payments experience.

 - Experience managing, coaching, or mentoring junior team members.

Note: we don't require a specific degree. We care about demonstrated capability and outcomes.




WHAT WE OFFER

The compensation range for this role is $188,000 to $210,000. We also offer significant stock options, full benefits, a bonus plan, commuter benefits, and a very desirable office with free drink and food options.



With the backing of our venture investors— Union Square Ventures, Canvas Ventures, Euclidean Capital, and Unlock Venture Partners — a dedicated following of hundreds of thousands of customers, and an extraordinary team, we are unwavering in our fight for financial fairness. As one of only a few FinTech Public Benefit Corporations, we’ve baked our dual dedication to building a profitable and socially impactful company into our charter; we only succeed when our customers do too. Give us a shout if you’d like to help us ship financial products that protect consumers from predatory lending practices and promote economic health.

Possible Finance is dedicated to financial fairness and community empowerment. We welcome diverse perspectives and experiences to help us achieve our mission of unlocking economic mobility for generations to come.

Since our founding, we’ve delivered over $1 billion in funding to more than 1 million customers and saved them over $500 million. At Possible, we’re building a new kind of consumer finance company, one that helps people stay out of debt rather than profit from keeping them in it.



Team Introduction

We’re filling a role on our Cash Access Technology (”CAT”) team dedicated to building and maintaining our best-in-class lending and cash access products. This includes the Possible Loan and the Possible Advance product lines, as well as future products in the cash access and lending space. The CAT team’s purpose is to:

 1. Maximize business impact and customer growth opportunities for our cash access product lines

 2. Provide an exceptional customer experience that drives repayment and customer satisfaction

 3. Proactively stay in compliance, identify areas for improvement, and ensure our mission-critical technical services operate effectively and efficiently, in partnership with our Loan Operations and LMS (Loan Management System) team
    



The Role & Impact

We’re looking for a seasoned product leader to oversee the Cash Access Team at Possible. This person will report to our Product Management Director. In this role, you’ll serve as the owner of:

 1. Our best-in-class short-term loan, serving hundreds of thousands of customers as an alternative to payday loans that trap customers in the debt cycle

 2. Our recently launched cash advance products, aiming to help address customers' short-term access needs between paychecks

 3. New tests into additional lending and access products as we strive to meet the needs of more customers

This is a critical role, responsible for leading and growing the heartbeat of the Possible business. We are looking for a senior product leader with proven experience driving a consumer credit and access business forward while partnering effectively with our compliance, ops, bizops, data science, credit risk, design, and engineering teams.



What You’ll Do

 - Manage the Cash Access product suite, optimizing the acquisition and repayment experiences to address customer liquidity needs and ensure success in repayment

 - Own the KPIs that drive the business: approval rate, repayment rate, conversion rate, repeat rate, progression, retention, and CSAT

 - Drive expansion and growth opportunities for the products, launching in new states and expanding on the overall product strategy of our flagship products

 - Create and execute a product roadmap that sets Possible up for long term success, delivers compelling customer experiences, and achieves business results

 - Communicate our product strategy, product health, business results, customer insights to Possible’s Leadership Team and the company (i.e., at all hands) on a consistent basis

 - Partner with Loan Operations and LMS product counterparts, Legal & Compliance, Data Science, Risk, and Customer Operations to manage state-level audits, health checks, and reviews with our banking partners

 - Increase the efficacy of our product development processes by introducing industry best practices


What You’ll Bring

 - 8+ years of hands-on product management experience in financial services or fintech, with a deep understanding of consumer credit

 - A balance of customer focus and technical and data prowess: diving deep into critical systems while thinking broadly about product strategy and the customer experience

 - Passion for leading cross-functional product teams to deliver great results, and readiness to roll up your sleeves and go deep with your team: setting the vision, charting the course, and clearing obstacles to achieve success

 - A strong reputation for managing the product development processes with discipline and efficiency

 - A deep sense of ownership and accountability for both the failures and successes of a product, paired with strong problem-solving skills to calmly tackle any challenge

 - High comfort working in a fast-paced environment (preferably through experience in one or more start-ups)

 - Ability to translate customer insights into product features and clearly communicate context and detailed requirements to engineers and product designers

 - Strong project management experience, with the ability to spot and remove cross-functional dependencies and help the team execute with speed and efficiency

 - Proven success working within industry regulations while delivering creative solutions

 - Passion for serving customers and driving positive societal change



Why You Should Join

 - A profitable and growing $100M+ business today with extraordinary demand and upside potential

 - A mission-driven team committed to building financial products that put customers first

 - Opportunity to build and execute a 3+ year plan to continue expanding access to affordable credit

 - A deeply integrated cross-functional organization spanning Product, Design, Marketing, and Engineering, with ownership of the end-to-end customer experience


Location

This is a Hybrid position. We work in our centrally located office in downtown Seattle three days a week (M, T, and Th).
